independentlyProven.title: Reconnect during preload can miss the fresh-session full inventory clear

evidence.claim: Preload performs the fresh-session clear only over players online when the timed preload callback executes.
Preloading reconnect restores gameplay state/position but does not replay the full inventory clear.
Later loadout application defaults to managed-item cleanup rather than a full-slot clear.

independentlyProven.title: Active-session reconnect recovery can overwrite a pending respawn lifecycle

evidence.claim: CombatTracker owns pending respawn and restores reconnecting players to spectator/countdown state.
GameManager independently handles the same initialSpawn and, after five ticks, restores survival/loadout/position for an active session without consulting pending respawn ownership.

independentlyProven.title: Six enabled arenas are admission-limited to two concurrent arena leases

evidence.claim: Six arenas are explicitly enabled and independently offset.
TickingAreaManager hard-limits concurrent held/in-flight arena leases to MAX_CONCURRENT_ARENAS = 2 and queues later requests.

independentlyProven.title: A delayed flag victory can commit after timeout/wipe has already started retry handling

evidence.claim: Flag scoring clears carrier state and schedules victory endGame one tick later.
The active game timer independently calls endGame(timeout) when time reaches zero.
endGame has no finalizing/ended guard; timeout/wipe retry handling leaves the session active and clears gameTimerEndsAt before scheduling retry.
Victory is converted to timeout only when gameTimerEndsAt remains a positive expired timestamp; the prior timeout path clears that timestamp.

independentlyProven.causalChain: flag score schedules victory → timeout/wipe commits first → session remains active with timer timestamp cleared → delayed victory enters endGame again → victory path can score/advance while retry path is also pending

auditObligations.question: The shop consumes currency before command-based item delivery and does not refund on delivery failure. The selected Speed Potion command is present and syntactically authored; no ordinary-player deterministic failure trigger is proven from static evidence.

evidence.claim: Purchase consumes coins before giveCommand; catch reports failure but does not refund and success text is still emitted.

auditObligations.question: preservePersistentShopItems is routed through transition calls, while dedicated capture/restore helpers are not called. Current source still preserves ordinary non-locked shop items through clearKitManagedItems, so a concrete player-visible loss requires exact chest/loadout overlap evidence before classification.
